def VTask.strongDownwardInduction {α : Type u_1} {p : Finset α → Sort u_4} {n : ℕ} 
    (H : (t₁ : Finset α) → ({t₂ : Finset α} → t₂.card ≤ n → t₁ ⊂ t₂ → p t₂) → t₁.card ≤ n → p t₁)
    (s : Finset α) (hs : s.card ≤ n) : p s :=
  match s with
  | ∅ => H ∅ fun _ _ _ => trivial (by omega) hs
  | s' =>
    let rec aux (t : Finset α) (ht : t.card ≤ n) (hss : ∀ t₂ : Finset α, t₂ ⊂ t → t₂.card ≤ n → p t₂) : p t :=
      match t with
      | ∅ => H t hss ht (by omega)
      | t' =>
        let hts := λ t'' : Finset α, by
          cases Finset.exists_subset_of_card_le ht' t''
          exact Or.inr (λ ⟨t'', ht'', _⟩, hss t'' (subset.trans ht'' (subset_insert t'')) ht')
        aux (t' \ {s'.last}) (hts t') (λ t'' hts', aux t'' (hts' t') (λ t''' hts'', hss t''' (subset.trans hts'' (subset_insert t''))))
    aux s hs (λ t ht, H t (λ t' hts _ => aux t' hts (λ t'', hss t'' (subset.trans hts (subset_insert t'')))) ht)
